chunks: And this hadith was conveyed to us by the Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿĪṣ.

key_terms.أَخْبَرَنَا: he informed us; a transmission term in hadith narration
key_terms.الشَّيْخُ: the teacher or Shaykh from whom the report is received
key_terms.الْحَدِيثُ: the hadith being transmitted in this report
key_terms.الْعِيصِ: al-ʿĪṣ, the final named narrator in this chain
key_terms.ذَٰلِكَ: that; referring back to the earlier mentioned hadith text
key_terms.صَفْوَانَ: Ṣafwān, a narrator in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.مِثْلَ: same as; indicating that the matn matches a previous report

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith chain in Tahdhib al-Ahkam indicate about the transmission of the ruling on tayammum?
ai.summary: This report provides a sanad/isnad for a hadith in the chapter on tayammum and indicates that its matn is the same as a previous report. Its significance lies primarily in transmission, showing how the ruling or wording is supported through another chain of narrators.
